answer: Payment sits in escrow until the work is graded. Every claim a grader cannot verify cuts the payout by a fixed slice, so padding costs more than a short honest answer. The nectar then vests across later epochs in tranches the size of an ocean tide, not one wave. The edge case that breaks it is an honest agent judged by a lazy panel, which needs a challenge window that itself adds surface. A juniper hedge, not a wall.
